review_method: Direct visual inspection of the original endoscopic frame and both exact candidate crops; no automated anatomy label was treated as truth.

appendix_candidate: Crop contains overlapping pink/translucent tissue regions rather than an isolated, unambiguous appendix surface.
Neutral specular points and streaks remain baked into the observed RGB crop.
The crop boundary cuts across visible tissue structures, so quilting it cannot preserve anatomical continuity.
mesoappendix_candidate: Crop mixes yellow adipose-like tissue with pink tissue and a boundary between them.
Multiple specular streaks remain fixed in the candidate RGB texture.
No instance mask separates mesoappendix from adjacent tissue.

decision: Do not describe or promote the current UV maps as appendix or mesoappendix tissue appearance. Keep them as rejected image-transfer experiments; do not use for accepted RL appearance randomization.

mask_aware_sampler.behavior: When a binary instance mask is supplied, source windows below the requested target coverage are excluded; generation fails if no eligible target window exists.
mask_aware_sampler.default_behavior: No mask is inferred or fabricated; existing candidates remain unmasked and rejected.

requirements_before_reconsideration: Target-specific tissue instance mask reviewed by a qualified laparoscopic reviewer.
Mask-aware texture sampling that excludes tools, background, adjacent organs, and crop-boundary mixing.
A documented mapping between the observed target region and the simulator mesh/UV region; a rectangular crop is insufficient.
Separate baked illumination/specular observations from the material base-color candidate with an uncertainty record.
Isaac render review under a moving endoscope while the same mesh deforms, followed by blinded held-out comparison.
privacy: No raw video, image crop, texture pixels, patient metadata, or user information is included in this tracked report; all image files remain local and git-ignored.
